cond_0001.intro:
This role is the engineering authority for the multidisciplinary design of PDU products Data Center applications. Ideal candidates should have working knowledge of Data Center and telecommunication installations, constituent components, management of, and related software tools. This knowledge is then applied as a base for the architecting of solutions and development of requirements for power distribution, power protection, and energy storage subsystems, including related software, software tools, and peripherals, that meet customer use cases and/or roadmap project objectives.
This role is responsible to ensure product level requirements and maintain traceability to the full verification and validation of the design. This position involves close interaction with all related development engineers, product architects, regional sales leaders, and regional tech managers, as well as key end-user customers. Furthermore, this role is the key technical liaison with external development partners.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Develop deep technical knowledge and understanding of power products for end-user applications/use-cases
Define technical requirements that are traceable and verifiable for products and projects working closely with all design engineering disciplines, including external development partners and seed end-customers
Support engineering development process including design, gate, and customer reviews
Ensure design solution alignment to customer definitions and needs
Support and develop system requirements, integration and verification
Create and maintain systems models
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree or above in Systems, Software, or Computer Science/Electrical Engineering or equivalent
Experience with Software design and related requirements
Direct experience in power distribution and/or power conversion
Proven application of systems development lifecycle
Strong communication and presentation skills
Experience with compiling technical requirements, VCRMs, and maintaining traceability from concept through production
Preferred Requirements
Ideally 10+ years working experience, preferably with 5+ years direct experience with power electronics and architecture
Experience/use of SysML/UML
Knowledgeable in computer networking architectures, topologies and hardware
Creative problem-solving and diagnostic/troubleshooting abilities
Fluent in project management, including Microsoft Project, and MS Office applications

[Company name masked] is a leading design and manufacturer of electromechanical solutions for computer data center and consumer appliance industries including both OEM and branded product solutions.
This role is the engineering authority for the multidisciplinary design of PDU products Data Center applications. Ideal candidates should have working knowledge of Data Center and telecommunication installations, constituent components, management of, and related software tools. This knowledge is then applied as a base for the architecting of solutions and development of requirements for power distribution, power protection, and energy storage subsystems, including related software, software tools, and peripherals, that meet customer use cases and/or roadmap project objectives.
This role is responsible to ensure product level requirements and maintain traceability to the full verification and validation of the design. This position involves close interaction with all related development engineers, product architects, regional sales leaders, and regional tech managers, as well as key end-user customers. Furthermore, this role is the key technical liaison with external development partners.
cond_0012.responsibilities:
Develop deep technical knowledge and understanding of power products for end-user applications/use-cases
Define technical requirements that are traceable and verifiable for products and projects working closely with all design engineering disciplines, including external development partners and seed end-customers
Support engineering development process including design, gate, and customer reviews
Ensure design solution alignment to customer definitions and needs
Support and develop system requirements, integration and verification
Create and maintain systems models
cond_0012.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Systems, Software, or Computer Science/Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 10 years of working experience, ideally with around 5 years of direct experience with power electronics and architecture, though relevant combinations of education and experience will be considered.
Some experience with software design and related requirements.
Background in power distribution and/or power conversion.
Familiarity with SysML/UML.
Exposure to systems development lifecycle practices.
Working knowledge of computer networking architectures, topologies, and hardware.
Ability to communicate effectively and present technical information clearly.
Experience with compiling technical requirements, VCRMs, and maintaining traceability from concept through production.
Willingness to apply problem-solving and diagnostic/troubleshooting approaches.
Comfort with project management tools including Microsoft Project and MS Office applications.

[Company name masked] is a leading design and manufacturer of electromechanical solutions for computer data center and consumer appliance industries including both OEM and branded product solutions.
This role is the engineering authority for the multidisciplinary design of PDU products Data Center applications. Ideal candidates should have working knowledge of Data Center and telecommunication installations, constituent components, management of, and related software tools. This knowledge is then applied as a base for coordinating the architecting of solutions and development of requirements for power distribution, power protection, and energy storage subsystems, including related software, software tools, and peripherals, that meet customer use cases and/or roadmap project objectives.
This role works to ensure product level requirements and maintain traceability to the full verification and validation of the design. This position involves close interaction with all related development engineers, product architects, regional sales leaders, and regional tech managers, as well as key end-user customers. Furthermore, this role serves as the key technical liaison with external development partners.
cond_0342.responsibilities:
Build deep technical knowledge and understanding of power products for end-user applications/use-cases
Work closely with all design engineering disciplines, including external development partners and seed end-customers, to define technical requirements that are traceable and verifiable for products and projects
Support engineering development process including design, gate, and customer reviews
Help ensure design solution alignment to customer definitions and needs
Collaborate on system requirements, integration and verification
Create and maintain systems models
cond_0342.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree or above in Systems, Software, or Computer Science/Electrical Engineering or equivalent
Ideally 10+ years working experience, preferably with 5+ years direct experience with power electronics and architecture
Experience with Software design and related requirements
Direct experience in power distribution and/or power conversion
Experience/use of SysML/UML
Proven application of systems development lifecycle
Knowledgeable in computer networking architectures, topologies and hardware
Strong communication and presentation skills
Experience with compiling technical requirements, VCRMs, and maintaining traceability from concept through production
Creative problem-solving and diagnostic/troubleshooting abilities
Fluent in project management, including Microsoft Project, and MS Office applications

[Company name masked] designs and manufactures electromechanical solutions for computer data center and consumer appliance industries, covering both OEM and branded product solutions.
This role is the engineering authority for the multidisciplinary design of PDU products for Data Center applications. Candidates should have working knowledge of Data Center and telecommunication installations, constituent components, and related software tools. That knowledge is applied to architect solutions and develop requirements for power distribution, power protection, and energy storage subsystems — including related software, tools, and peripherals — that meet customer use cases and roadmap project objectives.
This role is responsible for maintaining product-level requirements and traceability through full verification and validation of the design. It involves coordination with development engineers, product architects, regional sales leaders, regional tech managers, and key end-user customers, as well as serving as the technical liaison with external development partners.
cond_0520.responsibilities:
Build deep technical knowledge of power products for end-user applications and use cases
Define traceable and verifiable technical requirements for products and projects, coordinating with design engineering disciplines, external development partners, and select end-customers as needed for requirements clarity
Support engineering development processes including design, gate, and customer reviews
Ensure design solutions align to customer definitions and needs
Support and develop system requirements, integration, and verification
Create and maintain systems models
cond_0520.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree or above in Systems, Software, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent
Ideally 10+ years of working experience, preferably with 5+ years of direct experience in power electronics and architecture
Experience with software design and related requirements
Direct experience in power distribution and/or power conversion
Experience with SysML/UML
Proven application of systems development lifecycle
Knowledgeable in computer networking architectures, topologies, and hardware
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting
Experience compiling technical requirements, VCRMs, and maintaining traceability from concept through production
Strong problem-solving and diagnostic/troubleshooting abilities
Proficient in project management tools including Microsoft Project and MS Office applications
cond_0520.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Ideal candidates should have working knowledge of Data Center and telecommunication installations, constituent components, management of, and related software tools. This knowledge is then applied as a base for the architecting of solutions and development of requirements for power distribution, power protection, and energy storage subsystems, including related software, software tools, and peripherals, that meet customer use cases and/or roadmap project objectives.
This role is responsible to ensure product level requirements and maintain traceability to the full verification and validation of the design. This position involves close interaction with all related development engineers, product architects, regional sales leaders, and regional tech managers, as well as key end-user customers. Furthermore, this role is the key technical liaison with external development partners.
cond_0560.responsibilities:
Develop deep technical knowledge and understanding of power products for end-user applications/use-cases
Define technical requirements that are traceable and verifiable for products and projects working closely with all design engineering disciplines, including external development partners and seed end-customers
Support engineering development process including design, gate, and customer reviews
Ensure design solution alignment to customer definitions and needs
Support and develop system requirements, integration and verification
Create and maintain systems models
cond_0560.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Systems, Software, Computer Science, or Electrical Engineering required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 10 years of demonstrated expertise in systems engineering, with at least 5 years of direct, proven experience with power electronics and architecture.
Proven track record in power distribution and/or power conversion.
Deep knowledge of the systems development lifecycle and its application in complex engineering environments.
Advanced knowledge of computer networking architectures, topologies, and hardware.
Strong command of technical requirements compilation, VCRMs, and maintaining traceability from concept through production.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively across engineering, sales, and customer-facing contexts.
Preferred Requirements
Expertise in Software design and related requirements development.
Proficiency in SysML/UML with demonstrated application on real projects.
Solid understanding of project management principles, including strong command of Microsoft Project and MS Office applications.
Proven diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities, with a track record of solving complex, multidisciplinary technical problems.

cond_0644.intro:
This role is the engineering authority for the multidisciplinary design of PDU products for Data Center applications. Ideal candidates should have working knowledge of Data Center and telecommunication installations, constituent components, management of, and related software tools. This knowledge is then applied as a base for the architecting of solutions and development of requirements for power distribution, power protection, and energy storage subsystems, including related software, software tools, and peripherals, that meet customer use cases and/or roadmap project objectives.
This role is responsible to ensure product level requirements and maintain traceability to the full verification and validation of the design. This position involves close interaction with all related development engineers, product architects, regional sales leaders, and regional tech managers, as well as key end-user customers. Furthermore, this role is the key technical liaison with external development partners. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with systems engineering and power distribution work.
